description.en: parallel worktrees, multi-IDE agents, and cloud/local hybrid workflows
description.zh: 并行 worktree、多 IDE Agent、云端/本地混合工作流

goal.en: Run multiple agents in parallel across IDEs
goal.zh: 跨 IDE 并行驱动多个 Agent

outcome.en: Run parallel git worktrees with Cursor SDK, Windsurf+Devin, and Claude Code simultaneously — local agents for fast iteration, cloud agents for long-running tasks, adaptive model routing for optimal results per task type.
outcome.zh: 同时用 Cursor SDK、Windsurf+Devin 和 Claude Code 运行并行 git worktree——本地 Agent 做快速迭代，云端 Agent 跑长时任务，自适应模型路由为每类任务选择最优模型。

reason.en: Orchestrate multi-IDE agent workflows with Cursor SDK, Windsurf+Devin, worktree parallelism, and adaptive model routing.
reason.zh: 用 Cursor SDK、Windsurf+Devin、worktree 并行和自适应模型路由编排多 IDE Agent 工作流。

en: Set up parallel worktrees for frontend, backend, and tests
Configure Windsurf Devin for cloud-based debugging
Route code review tasks to the strongest model
zh: 为前端、后端和测试设置并行 worktree
配置 Windsurf Devin 做云端调试
把代码审查任务路由到最强模型

reason.en: Manage PRs, CI, and issues from any agent — keep your repo in sync across parallel workstreams.
reason.zh: 从任意 Agent 管理 PR、CI 和 Issue——让仓库在并行工作流中保持同步。

en: Check CI status across all my worktrees
Create a PR from the frontend worktree
Review PRs while the backend agent is still running
zh: 检查所有 worktree 的 CI 状态
从前端 worktree 创建 PR
在后端 Agent 仍在运行时审查 PR

reason.en: Delegate to Claude Code or Codex when you need deep coding — the self-driving dev delegates everything except architecture decisions.
reason.zh: 需要深度编码时委托给 Claude Code 或 Codex——自动驾驶开发者只做架构决策，其余全委托。

en: Delegate the API migration to a background coding agent
Have Codex write tests for all three worktrees
Run this refactor in a parallel Claude Code session
zh: 把 API 迁移委托给后台 coding agent
让 Codex 为三个 worktree 写测试
在并行 Claude Code 会话中运行这个重构
